$comment: RECORDED AGAINST THE UNFIXED TREE (Property 16 baseline). Assert mode is the default; PRESERVE=record rewrites this file. Do not hand-edit.
tuple: n:<name> and m:<name> KV state, excluding meta.k

normalization.meta.k: EXCLUDED. Does not exist in F; task 5 adds it. design.md's tuple excludes it explicitly.
normalization.meta.h: Replaced with <token-hash>. Derived from a random per-note edit token.
normalization.x-created-at / x-expires-at / json creat: Replaced with <iso> / <ms>. Wall-clock. The TTL *window* is preserved separately as ttlWindowSec, and 'each edit resets the expiry window' is preserved as metaCtChanged, so 3.4's semantics stay observable without recording clock noise.
normalization.x-edit-token / json editToken: Replaced with <token>. Random per note. Presence is still pinned, and tokenAppearsIn records the exact set of places the raw token value occurs — which is what D1 must not widen.
normalization.x-edit-url / json editUrl: Replaced with <url-with-token>: the URL embeds the random token.
normalization.set-cookie: Value replaced with <value>: the admin session token is HMAC-over-now.
normalization.server-allocated note names: Replaced with <random> for the one create that omits `name`.
normalization./admin/stats day keys: Relabelled day0..day6, newest first: they are today's date, and Promise.all completion order makes the raw key order unstable.
normalization./admin/stats rejection counts: Replaced with <count>. These counts are exactly what D2 changes (a lost telemetry write is the defect), so recording them would encode the bug as an expectation. Shape, status and code set are still pinned; the numbers are Property 4/6's job.
Bytes not recorded; only status, content-type and marker presence. Task 8 edits these files on purpose, and a documentation edit must not read as a preservation regression.
normalization.response bodies over 512 chars: Truncated with a …<truncated> suffix; byteLength is recorded alongside.
normalization.HTML bodies: Recorded as <title> plus a fixed marker table (which branch answered), not as full HTML — test/__snapshots__/views.test.ts.snap owns the markup.

notExercised.unsafe_target: Unreachable in the test environment: checkSafeBrowsing() no-ops without SAFE_BROWSING_KEY.
notExercised.content_blocked: Unreachable in the test environment: env.AI.run throws ('Binding AI needs to be run remotely') and aiModerate fails open.
notExercised.bad_scheme: Unreachable through the public API in F, for any input: hasDangerousScheme() is only consulted when isUrl() is true, and every javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: string fails URL_NO_SCHEME_RE, while an isUrl()-true string is always normalized to http(s). The two gate-bad-scheme-* entries record what F ACTUALLY does with those inputs (creates a text note) so a fix that changes it shows up. Not fixed here — out of scope.
